Rishi / team — quick finance note. Summary below and action items.

Retention summary (canonical):
- Invoice PDFs & tax invoices: retained for accounting purposes for 7 years (we keep PDF/archival copies in the accounting bucket).
- Invoice metadata (line items, invoice id, amounts): retained as part of the billing ledger for 7 years; we can export line-level CSV for auditing.
- Raw per-request usage logs (payloads, prompt content): retained for up to 90 days in production by default, longer only if under a retention hold; these are typically subject to DSR erasure requests and may not be available to export if the DSR requires deletion of content tied to a subject.

What we can provide to Acme:
1) Canonical invoice PDFs for the requested period (redaction: billing addresses and any PII that is not required by Acme — we can keep client-visible identifiers).
2) Billing ledger extract (CSV) with columns: invoice_id, invoice_date, amount, currency, product_code, line_description, billing_period_start, billing_period_end. We will exclude internal request IDs that contain customer content.
3) Evidence manifest (PDF) — checksums (SHA256) for each invoice PDF and the ledger extract, generation timestamp, and a short statement describing our retention policy and whether any usage logs were affected by the DSR.

Constraints & notes:
- If Acme's DSR included erasure for user-generated content tied to invoice metadata (rare), we may need a legal hold to preserve billing artifacts until Finance/Legal clear the production.
- Generating the invoice zip + ledger extract + manifest: estimate 2 business days once Legal signs off on the redaction template. I attached a draft manifest (invoice_manifest_draft.csv) with skeleton columns.

Action items:
- Marissa: can you confirm whether Acme will sign a short preservation acknowledgement (plain-language) that allows us to hold billing artifacts for the time needed to produce evidence? If they refuse, we provide an attestation of non-availability for logs but still deliver invoices/ledger where possible.
- Karhik: infra note — if we need to pull archived billing ledger snapshots, any objections? We may need a read-only job which is fine.

I’ll proceed once we have Marissa’s confirmation and a nod from legal on the redaction approach.

-Neha
Finance Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Quick update and a proposed handoff so procurement/audit at Acme can close their hold.

What Redwood will provide:
- Invoice package: PDFs for Jan 2025—Apr 2027 (redacted for any fields we don't need to disclose, e.g., internal notes).
- Billing ledger extract: CSV with invoice_id, invoice_date, amount, currency, product_code, line_description, billing_period_start/end. This is intended to be a machine-friendly ledger extract that maps to the invoice PDFs.
- Evidence manifest: PDF containing SHA256 checksums for each file, generation timestamp, and a short statement of Redwood's retention policy for billing artifacts.

Important clarifications re: DSR vs billing retention:
- Accounting artifacts (invoices and the canonical ledger) are retained for accounting and tax compliance and are not deleted as part of routine DSR erasure workflows without a specific legal exception. In practice we keep those artifacts for seven years.
- Operational usage logs that contain user-generated content (prompts, raw responses) are governed by the DSR and may be removed. If those logs are necessary to reconcile a usage line item, Finance will provide an attestation describing the reconciliation methodology instead of raw logs.

Timeline: Neha confirms we can produce the package within 2 business days after we have a redaction checklist from Legal. To keep this moving, would Acme sign a simple preservation acknowledgement that allows us to temporarily hold and export accounting artifacts while we compile them? This is standard in joint DSR/evidence cases and prevents accidental erasure. If you can confirm by EOD Mon (2027-05-24) we’ll aim to deliver the package by Wed (2027-05-26).

Next steps (requested from Acme):
- Confirm acceptance of the proposed artifacts (PDF invoices + CSV ledger + manifest).
- Sign the preservation acknowledgement (one-paragraph doc we can send).

I’ve CC'd Neha and Marissa to coordinate production and any pricing/billing questions. We’ll include the manifest and an internal statement of non-availability for any logs that are affected by the DSR.

Best,
